description: The daemon's `config.yaml` in the configuration home. See https://github.com/vojtechmares/coding-owl#daemon-configuration.

limits.description: What this Account is held to, as percentages of its rate-limit windows, counting what you spent yourself.

fiveHourMax.description: The share of the five-hour window Owl will not schedule past.

weeklyMax.description: The share of the weekly window Owl will not schedule past.

maxParallel.description: How many Runs may draw on this Account at once. Unset is unlimited, because the Ceiling already governs burn rate.

accounts.description: What each Account is held to. The key is the Account's name.

claudePath.description: Where the coding tool is, when the daemon's PATH does not say. An absolute path.

credentialStore.description: Where an Account's secret is kept. The default is the keychain on macOS.

garbageCollection.description: How often Owl reconciles the worktrees on disk against the Jobs in its database.

interval.description: How often finished worktrees are reclaimed, like `1h`.

reviewAfter.description: How long a Job may wait for a decision before it is reported.

graceWindow.description: How long a Run is given to finish after Owl asks it to stop, like `15m`.

idle.description: When the machine counts as idle, and so when Owl may work.

after.description: How long without keyboard or mouse input counts as idle, like `10m`.

interval.description: How often the machine is read. At least `50ms`.

requirePower.description: Whether the machine must be on AC power.

maxParallelRuns.description: How many Runs may go at once. At least one; stopping the daemon is how nothing runs.

phases.description: What each phase of a Job runs as, and how long it may take.

effort.description: How hard this phase thinks, like `xhigh`.

model.description: What this phase runs as, like `anthropic/claude-opus`. `owl models` lists them.

stall.description: The longest this phase's Agent may go without saying anything, like `15m`.

timeout.description: The longest this phase's Agent may run at all, like `4h`.
